title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Creditless Ending Scene Video From Episode 5
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 revealed the non-credit ending video from Episode 5 “DEFEND YOU.” The anime previously revealed Ichigo’s new Blood Chains form that was also introduced in the episode, which was mostly anime-original. The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for a total 10 episodes.

The new video features the ending song “Rasen” by 9Lana and features Orihime Inoue’s scene from the end of the latest episode. You can watch the video below.

ALSO READ: BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: Midori Amagaeru, Tsukasa Kyoka's 'Online - The Comic' Manga Ends
content:
Manga Box published the 255th and final chapter of Midori Amagaeru and Tsukasa Kyoka 's Online: The Comic manga on August 14. Amagaeru shared an illustration celebrating the end of the manga.

The manga launched on DeNA 's MangaBox app in 2013. The English version of the app, which also launched in 2013, also published the manga digitally in English, until MangaBox discontinued its English app. MangaBox describes the story:

Mai Yashiro (22) was an average office worker until the day a video game console arrived in her mailbox. The game she is forced to play, “Nightmare,” is a dangerous game in which one risks both the lives of the ones they love and their own body!! If you refuse to play, those dear to you die. If you lose battles in the game, parts of your body (your arms or legs, your voice, etc.) cease functioning. The horror of this game spreads throughout society in a flash, and, to fight it, Mai's company creates a “Nightmare” Strategy Team. After being assigned to this team, Mai and her dependable comrades boldly rise up against this hellish game. Adapted from the super-popular novel which has received over 40,000,000 hits online!!

Everystar shipped the 23rd compiled book volume on February 1. Amazon previously listed in 2020 the series as ending with the 15th volume.

Amagaeru launched the original novel series in 2011, and Kadokawa published the 27th novel in May 2024.

title: 1 Year Later, Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Solo Leveling’s Breakout Replacement
content:
Solo Leveling confirmed an anime sequel in July this year, more than a year after the second season finale. The series’ first feature-length film will follow the story after the fan-favorite Jeju Island Arc. However, the anime has yet to confirm a release window. While fans await Solo Leveling ‘s return, Crunchyroll began streaming just the perfect series for fans. Super Cube is a donghua that went viral last year thanks to its spectacular animation. In recent years, the Chinese animation industry has been on the rise thanks to unique stories and unique animation style. The fight choreography especially captured viewers’ eyes, even more than the story itself.

Crunchyroll often streams such series, including the beloved mystery drama Link Click and the popular isekai Lord of Mysteries . While Super Cube premiered in 2025, the platform wasn’t streaming it until now. The series is also available on Prime Video through the Crunchyroll Amazon Channel add-on. While Crunchyroll hasn’t made an official announcement yet, you can find all episodes of the first season on the website. The series debuted on Crunchyroll on August 21st, 2026, as fans await updates on the second season.

Will Super Cube Release a Season 2?

Although there are rumors circulating around the second season, the animation studio and the producers have yet to officially confirm it. Considering the popularity of the donghua, it wouldn’t be surprising if we get an official announcement soon. Now that Crunchyroll has also licensed the show, the chances of a sequel season have only skyrocketed. The donghua is based on a Chinese webtoon with over 300 chapters, so there’s a lot of story left to adapt.

The series centers around Wang Xiaoxiu, who has been in love with his childhood friend, Shen Yao, for as long as he can remember. After they both enrolled in college, she accepts his feelings for her, but that was only the beginning of his struggles. Xiaoxiu finds himself being targeted by a group of delinquents led by Sun Jun, who also wants to pursue Yao. After they threw Xiaoxiu into the river, the ordinary college student finds a mysterious cube that merges with his body and grants him unique powers. The second season will continue his journey as he combats the threats around him with the help of his newfound abilities.

How Is Super Cube Similar to Solo Leveling ?

While both series are different at their cores, they do have the same narrative structure. Both series follow the underdog protagonists who gain extraordinary powers after a near-death situation. Not to mention that even the dark-haired appearance of both protagonists is somewhat similar. While Xiaoxiu’s main power is teleportation, it is also an ability Jinwoo is capable of using.

After Xiaoxiu gained his new powers, he does everything he can to become good at fighting, which is pretty much the same thing Jinwoo had going for him . However, despite the similarities, both series have completely different power systems and overall world-building.

title: 'Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Chinkururi and Nanashina 's Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu: Saikyou no Bishoujo Gundan wo Tsukuriagero ( Gacha Girls Corps ) light novel announced a pair of additional cast on Sunday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Voice actresses Ai Kayano ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) and Rie Kugimiya ( Gintama ) are joining the cast as Shisuha Aibi and Luna Varad, respectively.

Takashi Asami ( Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu episode director) is helming the anime at Zero-G and Saber Works . Deko Akao ( Norigami Arigato ) is handling the series composition. Mineo Suzuki ( Konyaku Haki sareta Reijou wo Hirotta Ore ga, Ikenai Koto wo Oshiekomu ) is designing the characters and serving as the chief animation director. Hiroaki Tsutsumi ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) and George King are composing the music.

Chinkururi originally published the fantasy adventure novel with illustrations by Nanashina as a web novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2016. Micro Magazine published the nine volumes under the GC Novels imprint between November 2016 and August 2020 featuring illustrations by Nanashina.

Comic Ride began serializing a manga adaptation by Shuu Haruno in March 2018. The 14th volume was released on June 29.

Kaiten Books licensed the manga adaptation in English in December 2020 and released the seventh volume digitally in September 2024.

title: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Gets 2027 Release Date
content:
Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 anime has officially announced a 2027 release date. The first season ran for 12 episodes from October to December 2023, with animation by studio ACGT. The announcement visual for Season 2 was previously shared in April. It features Fate and the Holy Knight Roxy holding hands to form the number “2.” Roxy is shown in a new outfit, which is set to debut in the sequel. Check that out below.

Berserk of Gluttony Season 1 Anime Staff & Cast:

The main voice cast from the first season includes:

• Ryota Osaka as Fate

• Tomokazu Seki as Greed

• Misato Matsuoka as Myne

• Hitomi Sekine as Eris

• Hisako Tojo as Roxy

You can see the staff below.

• Director: Tetsuya Yanagisawa

• Series Composition: Mariko Kunisawa

• Original Character Design: fame

• Character Design: Takafumi Furusawa

• Action Director: Shigeyuki Suga

• Prop Design: Hidefumi Kimura

• Color Design: Tomomi Ando

• Art Setting: Maho Takahashi

• Art Directors: Maika Hosoda, Eiji Iwase

• Director of Photography: Hiroaki Tanaka

• Editing: Motoki Niimi (REAL-T)

• Sound Director: Satoshi Yano

• Sound Effects: Hiromune Kurahashi

• Music: Yuichi Ohno

• Music Production: HIAN

• Music Producer: Daisuke “DAIS” Miyachi

• Opening Theme: “Jekyll & Hyde” by EverdreaM

• Lyrics/Composition/Production: ROCK★PANDA, HIPTIPPTIP

• Ending Theme: “Blue Gem” by EverdreaM

• Lyrics: 40mP, Composition/Production: ROCK★PANDA, HIPTIP

• OP/ED Artist: EverdreaM (Misato Matsuoka, Hitomi Sekine)

• Produced by: GENCO

• Animation Studio: ACGT

Ichika Isshiki is the original author of the Berserk of Gluttony ( Boushoku no Berserk: Ore Dake Level to Iu Gainen o Toppa Sur ) series, which first started as a web novel on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website. It is currently serialized by Micro Magazine as a novel in GC Novels and GCN Bunko with illustrations by fame. There is also a manga adaptation, which has art by Daisuke Takino. The total circulation has surpassed 2.2 million copies. The official synopsis: In a world where the superiority of skills is absolute, a boy named Fate is scorned and belittled for his incompetence. This is because his skill, “Gluttony,” is completely useless except for making him hungry. Fate is forced to live at the bottom of society, enduring violence and being burdened with menial tasks by the prestigious Brellick family, who are among the highest-ranking Holy Knights in this world. The only solace he finds is in Roxy Heart, who, despite also being a Holy Knight, treats him with respect and kindness. However, everything changes when Fate accidentally kills a thief who infiltrates the castle while accompanying Roxy. In that moment, his Gluttony skill activates, allowing him to steal the opponent’s power and abilities. Fate’s skill is an incredible ability to take away skills and abilities from those he kills. Empowered by his newfound fighting abilities, Fate encounters Greed, a sentient sword with a skill known as “Greed,” also associated with one of the Deadly Sins. Together, they step into a world of conflict and struggle. Driven by the desire to protect his loved ones and defy the unjust world, Fate devours his enemies in order to consume their power. The destiny of this once-lowly boy, crawling on the ground, rapidly begins to unfold.

title: Berserk of Gluttony 2nd Season Anime Debuts in 2027
content:
Point Set announced on Sunday that the second season for the television anime of Ichika Isshiki and fame 's Berserk of Gluttony ( Bōshoku no Berserk: Ore Dake Level to Iu Gainen wo Toppa Suru ) light novel series will debut in 2027. Point Set also posted a celebratory video message from Ryōta Ōsaka , the voice of the anime's protagonist Fate Graphite.

The anime stars:

• Ryota Ohsaka as Fate Graphite

• Tomokazu Seki as the black sword Greed

• Hisako Tōjō as Roxy

• Misato Matsuoka as Myne

• Hitomi Sekine as Eris

Tetsuya Yanagisawa ( High School DxD , Orient ) directed the first season anime at ACGT. Mariko Kunisawa ( Ascendance of a Bookworm , Orient ) was in charge of series scripts, and Takafumi Furusawa designed the characters.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing both the novel series and its manga adaptation in English, and it describes the story:

Fate Graphite is one of the forsaken. Cursed with the skill “Gluttony,” he is ever starving, never sated…until the day he kills a dying thief and devours the man's strength—and his soul. The true hunger of Fate's Gluttony has awakened, and if he can learn to control his power, he will at last be the master of his own destiny.

After releasing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō service, Isshiki launched the first novel volume with illustrations by fame in November 2017. Micro Magazine is also releasing the novels in a larger bunko format. Daisuke Takino launched the manga adaptation on Micro Magazine 's Comic Ride website in April 2018.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Darkest Fantasy Returns With a Surprise U.S. Release Ahead of Season 3
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen is easily one of the most popular Shonen series in recent years, and most of its success is thanks to the stunning adaptation by Studio MAPPA. While the first season was more than intersting enough, the director changed in Season 2, making the series even more famous among fans. Over the years, MAPPA has released several critically acclaimed series, and it’s one of the most renowned studios in the industry. One of the beloved series from the studio is Dorohedoro , based on an award-winning manga written and illustrated by Q Hayashida. The anime premiered in 2020, two years after the manga reached its conclusion. Following the anime debut, the studio took six years to release a second season .

The sequel season gained even more popularity when it was released in April this year as part of the Spring 2026 anime lineup. While fans await updates on the third season, the official website of Viz Media reveals that the hardcover volume of Dorohedoro Illustrations: Mud and Sludge will be released in the U.S. on September 22nd, 2026. The manga is famous for its gritty details and stellar art style, which perfectly suits the tone of the story. The artbook features illustrations, sketches, paintings, and more by the original creator. Viz Media also shared the link to pre-order the artbook on Amazon.

Does Dorohedoro Season 3 Have a Release Date?

The third season hasn’t shared any updates on the release date or even a window. However, fans won’t have to wait another six years for a new season. Only a few days after the second season finale, MAPPA shared the first look at Season 3 during its 15th anniversary event in June. The 90-second trailer shares glimpses of what to expect from the story in the upcoming season.

Considering how the series has already dropped a massive update this early. We can expect more updates on the anime by the end of the year or in the first half of 2027. While the series originally premiered on Netflix, Crunchyroll also licensed both seasons this year. Fans can watch the anime on either platform, where we can also expect the third season to drop.

What to Expect From Dorohedoro Season 3

Caiman’s struggles to uncover the dark secrets about the Hole and his identity continue in the second season. The anime’s latest season ends on a massive cliffhanger as the story hints towards the connection between Aikawa, Caiman, and Kai. The story will take a drastic turn in the third season as Caiman is closer than ever to learning the truth about his identity. We can also expect the story to delve deeper into Nikaido’s dramatic awakening as well as the villains working in the shadows.

It won’t be the final season of the anime since there’s a huge chunk of story left to adapt. We can expect the anime to follow the same 12-episode format, covering around 35 to 40 chapters total. The cast and crew will be the same in the upcoming season as well, with Yuichiro Hayashi returning as the series director.

title: Live-Action One Piece Season 3 Reveals 4 New Cast Members
content:
The One Piece Day '26 livestream event on Sunday revealed new cast members for One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta , the third live-action season based on Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga .

The newly announced cast members are:

• Emilio Sakraya as Koza

• Omid Abtahi as Toto

• Nabeel Khan as Chaka

• Jamie Ward as Pell

The third season has previously cast Cole Escola as Bon Clay, Xolo Maridueña as Portgas D. Ace, Awdo Awdo as Mr. 1, and Daisy Head ( Dungeons and Dragons: Honor Among Thieves , Shadow and Bone ) as Miss Doublefinger.

Ian Stokes and Joe Tracz are co-showrunners, writers and executive producers for the third season.

One Piece: Into the Grand Line , the second live-action season , debuted on Netflix on March 10. The first two episodes played in over 200 theaters in Canada, the United States, and Japan on the same day.

The second season began production in July 2024. As series creator Oda previously stated , the second season covers the story up to the Drum Island arc. This includes Loguetown, Reverse Mountain and Twin Cape, Whiskey Peak, Little Garden, and Drum Island.

The second season added Joe Tracz ( Percy Jackson and the Olympians ) as a writer, executive producer, and co-showrunner. He joined the first season's writer, executive producer, and co-showrunner Matt Owens . Season 1 co-showrunner Steve Maeda served as executive producer. Owens announced in March 2025 he was leaving the show after production on season 2 ended to work on his mental health.

The live-action One Piece series debuted exclusively on Netflix in August 2023. The first season had eight episodes, as opposed to 10 episodes as originally reported. The series won awards for "Outstanding Original Song for a Children's or Young Teen Program" and "Outstanding Stunt Coordination for a Live Program" at The 3rd Annual Children's & Family Emmy Awards.

Tomorrow Studios , a partnership between producer Marty Adelstein ( Prison Break , Teen Wolf ) and ITV Studios, produced the first live-action season. Becky Clements served as an executive producer with Maeda.

title: Two New 'One Piece' Anime Movies for 2027 and 2029
content:
The second day of the " One Piece Day'26 " event at Makuhari Messe in Chiba announced on Sunday that Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga is receiving two new anime movies. The first film, titled One Piece Film God Valley , is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in Summer 2027, while the second film, One Piece Film Baad is set to release in 2029. The official website also revealed a special teaser promo and the logos of both films.

One Piece Film God Valley marks the first theatrical release for the franchise since One Piece Film: Red in August 2022, which earned 20.33 billion yen (approx. US$127.89 million) at the box office.

The first movie will coincide with the 30th anniversary of the manga's serialization on July 22, 2027. The title of the second movie, One Piece Film Baad , features a prominent letter "D" in its logo, which was handwritten by Oda himself.

Oda began serializing the adventure fantasy manga in Weekly Shounen Jump magazine in July 1997. Shueisha released the 115th volume on July 3. The manga has over 600 million cumulative copies of its volumes in circulation.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in November 2002 and released the 112th volume on July 7. The 113th volume is planned for a November 10 release. Crunchyroll streams the long-running television anime adaptation by Toei Animation .

title: One Piece God Valley Anime Movie Officially Announced for 2027, BAAD Film for 2029
content:
ONE PIECE new anime film is officially covering the God Valley Incident, one of the biggest events in the story. Oda previously teased the new film at Jump Festa 2026, saying it was about something he was sure everyone would be interested in . This will be the 15th movie for the franchise. In addition, ONE PIECE FILM: BAAD Was announced for 2029 The God Valley Incident featured the fight where Roger teamed up with Garp to fight against Rocks.

The last movie for the franchise was ONE PIECE FILM RED , which premiered in August 2022. The movie grossed over ¥2.25 billion (~$15 million), with 1.57 million attendees in the opening weekend in Japan. That made the biggest opening-weekend numbers when it came to both the audience and earnings among films of 2022. It also quickly became the best-performing film in ONE PIECE ‘s history.

The ONE PIECE franchise, created by Eiichiro Oda, is one of the most successful manga and anime series of all time. Since its serialization began in 1997, ONE PIECE has exceeded over 600 million copies in print worldwide. Chapter 1190 was released on August 9. The ONE PIECE anime, animated by Toei Animation, first premiered in 1999 and it entered the Elbaph Arc in April 2026 after a 3-month break.
